Question ID: SPEECH_U05_Pretest_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.COM.03

Unit 5 pretest item 1: Which choice shows readiness for revision, digital presentation, or publication skills?

answer.text: A. Use feedback to improve a speech draft

feedback.text: Correct. This choice supports publication-ready communication by improving clarity, collaboration, digital presentation, and audience understanding.

answer.text: B. Add more decoration instead of improving meaning

feedback.text: This choice may sound related, but it does not fully meet the communication purpose or collaboration standard.

answer.text: C. Ignore audience needs during final review

feedback.text: This choice reflects a misconception. Recheck revision, publication readiness, audience impact, or slide coherence.

answer.text: D. Let everyone edit without roles or version control

feedback.text: This choice weakens the communication product because it ignores how the audience will use or understand it.
